text: I have received multiple complaints from residents on Esther Lorrie Drive who are concerned about traffic safety related to on street parking between Jansusie Road and Kipling Avenue. During the winter months it is difficult to clear snow with vehicles parked on the street. Snow piles up next to parked cars and greatly reduces the lane width needed to accommodate two way traffic and the left turn lane to Kipling Avenue. I would ask that you support the recommendation below which would prohibit parking on the south side of Esther Lorrie Drive between Jansusie Road and Kipling Avenue.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Esther Lorrie Drive, between Jansusie Road and Kipling Avenue.
